home.meta.title: glyphfox: icons that move, morph and fuse
home.meta.description: Original open source icons with variable weight, corners and style, a morph engine, fusion, modifiers and living states. React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, web components, Tailwind and a CLI.
home.meta.og: Variable, morphable and fusable open source icons with a studio in the browser.
home.hero.lead: Original icons on a 24 grid with variable weight, corners and style, a morph engine, fusion, modifier badges and living states. The same props in React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, web components, Tailwind and the CLI.
home.install.label: Install command
home.stats.label: glyphfox in numbers
home.axes.title: One icon. Every weight.
home.axes.lead: Every icon renders along three axes: weight from 1 to 3 with optical compensation at small sizes, round or sharp corners, and outline, duotone or solid style generated from its closed shapes.
home.play.title: Dial it in.
home.play.lead: Drag the sliders. Every component in every framework takes the same props.
home.morph.title: Anything into anything.
home.morph.lead: Paths are normalized, resampled, matched and interpolated, so any icon turns into any other. Hand tuned pairs make the everyday ones feel designed.
home.living.title: Icons that know how to move.
home.living.lead: Presets that understand the icon: draw traces the strokes in order, shake swings from the top like a bell. Trigger them on mount, hover, click or a state prop. Reduced motion is always respected.
home.mods.title: Badges that cut their own gap.
home.mods.lead: Add plus, check, alert, lock, clock, sync and more in any corner. The icon underneath is trimmed around the badge, so a few hundred icons give thousands of clean combinations.
home.mp.title: Modifier playground
home.fusion.title: Two icons. One new glyph.
home.fusion.lead: Fuse 2 to 10 icons with seven layouts. Parts are scaled and snapped to the grid, and where they overlap the one behind is cut around the one in front, so lines never collide and the result still passes the lint.
home.gallery.title: New icons, already in the set.
home.studio.title: A whole icon workshop in your browser.
home.studio.lead: No account, no server. Everything runs on your machine and your collection stays in your browser.
tool.editor.desc: Draw on the 24 grid with pen and shape tools, node editing, undo and live lint.
tool.foxify.desc: Drop any SVG and get it back in the glyphfox style, with a before and after view.
tool.sketch.desc: Draw a rough shape and find the closest icons, right in the page.
tool.fusion.desc: Combine up to ten icons, drag and scale parts, tune the gap.
tool.brand.desc: Pick a color, weight, corners and style. Export a themed package, sprite, CSS, favicon and app icons.
tool.3d.desc: Extrude any icon in 3D with lighting and material presets and export a PNG.
home.fw.title: Same props. Every stack.
home.fw.lead: Tree shakable components, a custom element that works from a single script tag, a Tailwind plugin for v3 and v4, and a CLI that builds just the icons you need.
home.cta.title: Make your interface move.

docs.meta.title: Docs: glyphfox
docs.meta.description: Install glyphfox and use it with React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, the web component, the CDN, Tailwind CSS, plain HTML and the CLI. Every prop, the name syntax, morph, fusion, living states and modifiers.
docs.title: Everything glyphfox can do
docs.lead: One set of props in every framework. Learn the install, each package, the name syntax and the engines behind morph, fusion and living states.
docs.install.p: glyphfox has no dependencies. React, Vue, Svelte and Tailwind CSS are optional peer dependencies, used only when you import their entry points.
docs.react.p: Each icon is a tree shakable forwardRef component named after the icon: arrow-right becomes ArrowRightIcon. className, style and every SVG attribute pass through to the svg.
docs.react.p2: useMorph(name, options) returns icon data that morphs whenever the name changes, for custom renderers. registerIcons(icons) makes names available synchronously, for example during server rendering.
docs.vue.p: Props use the same names; in templates you can also write them in kebab-case (secondary-color). The useMorph(nameRef) composable mirrors the React hook.
docs.svelte.p: For Svelte 5. Components ship as .svelte files compiled by your app. morphStore(name) is a store that morphs on every set(name).
docs.angular.p: glyphfox-angular is published in the Angular package format, built with ng-packagr. GlyphFoxIcon is a standalone component; provideGlyphFox registers icons by name and default props.
docs.web.p: One file with every icon, the element and the plain HTML runtime. Every prop is an attribute in kebab-case. With a bundler, import glyphfox/web, or glyphfox/web/element to register only your icons. The morph attribute animates every change of name.
docs.tailwind.p: Icons render as CSS masks in currentColor, so color, size and opacity utilities apply. After the slash you can join axes, a fusion layout or a badge corner with dashes. Tailwind v4 only accepts + and & inside brackets; v3 also accepts gf-file+check.
docs.html.p: The runtime swaps every element with data-glyph for inline SVG, including elements added later. Props are data attributes in kebab-case.
docs.js.p: The package also ships icons.json, sprite.svg, styles.css, glyphfox/core (the engine without icon data) and glyphfox/tools (lint and Fox-ify).
docs.props.p: The same props, names and meaning in React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, the web component and toSvg. Plus class and style, passed to the svg (or to the host element for Angular and the web component).
prop.size: Width and height; numbers are pixels.
prop.secondaryColor: Color of the duotone layer and of the solid fill.
prop.secondaryOpacity: Opacity of the duotone layer or of the solid fill.
prop.weight: Stroke from 1 to 3 on the 24 grid, optically compensated below 24 px.
prop.absoluteWeight: Keeps the stroke at weight pixels at any size.
prop.corners: Round or sharp joins and caps.
prop.variant: Style axis; solid comes from the closed shapes.
prop.mirrorRtl: Mirror in right to left layouts.
prop.trigger: When the animation or the morph plays.
prop.loop: Repeat forever or a number of times (spin and pulse loop by default).
prop.modifier: Badge with an automatic knockout gap.
prop.morphTo: Morph target; the trigger decides when it shows.
prop.title: Accessible name: title, role img and aria-label.
prop.decorative: Hides the icon from assistive technology.
docs.syntax.p: Shared by the web component, the CDN, Tailwind, the CLI, the Icon component and toSvg.
syntax.corner: badge in a corner: tl, tr, bl, br
docs.axes.p: Weight runs from 1 to 3. Below 24 px the stroke grows a little so small icons keep their presence; absoluteWeight turns this off. Corners switch between round and sharp joins and caps. The solid style fills the closed outer shapes and cuts the inner lines out as negative space; it is computed at build time for the set and at render time for fusions and modifiers.
docs.morph.p: Paths are flattened into strands, matched with an optimal assignment, resampled to the same number of points, aligned and interpolated. Strands without a partner shrink and fade. Hand tuned hints cover the common pairs. Without JavaScript, toSvg with morphTo returns an SVG that morphs with a CSS d transition and cross fades where that is not supported.
docs.fusion.p: fuse combines 2 to 10 icons into one icon that still passes the lint. Layouts: overlap, side, stack, grid (2x2, 3x3 and 10 slots), orbit, badge and inside. Parts are scaled and snapped to the grid, and the part behind is trimmed around the part in front with a knockout gap. Options: layout, gap, weight, scale and offsets.
docs.living.p: Each preset is a small stylesheet inside the SVG, so it works everywhere the SVG goes. draw traces the strokes in drawing order, shake swings from the top. Triggers: mount, hover (the icon or its direct parent), click (replays on each click) and state (plays while active). Reduced motion turns every animation off.
docs.mods.p: Eleven badges in four corners. The icon underneath is trimmed around the badge geometrically, so the result is a plain icon that passes the lint, in every weight.
docs.cli.p: copy prints the snippet and puts it on the clipboard (formats: svg, jsx, vue, svelte, angular, html, tailwind, cdn, datauri). build makes a sprite, a CSS file with mask classes or a small package from a list. Every command takes the shared props as flags, such as --weight 1.5 --corners sharp.
docs.rules.p: Original drawings only, on a 24 by 24 grid: viewBox 0 0 24 24, no fill, stroke currentColor, stroke width 2, round caps and joins, 2 px padding, no transforms, and no fills except one optional duotone layer with the class gf-secondary. Sources live in icons/NAME.svg with a NAME.json sidecar for categories and tags, and tools/icons/lint.mjs checks them.
